payload.summary: Archive sweep over the 12 changes that /prioritize-proposals identified as done-but-unarchived. 9 archived and their spec deltas merged; 3 blocked on stale spec deltas that need their owner's judgement, not sweep mechanics. Open tasks migrated to two follow-up OpenSpec proposals per operator choice.

decisions.title: Archive oldest-first to respect delta ordering
decisions.rationale: derive-agent-identity-from-registry and extend-coordinator-keys-to-new-harnesses both MODIFY the same two agent-identity requirements; extract-gen-eval-package and rename-descriptor-model-levels both touch gen-eval-framework. Chronological order puts the base change first in both pairs.

decisions.title: Migrate surviving tasks to follow-up proposals, not coordinator issues
decisions.rationale: Operator chose the OpenSpec route. Both follow-ups declare skip_specs: true with schema: feature-workflow, because their parents already merged every behavioural requirement; the surviving work is documentation propagation and two scoping decisions.

decisions.title: Leave dead ceremony boxes unchecked, annotate instead
decisions.rationale: Nine open boxes (commit/push/Review/Done/Merge) describe work already on main. Back-filling them with [x] would assert first-hand completion that was only inferred from the merged artifact. Migration Notes record the inference and its evidence.

decisions.title: Stop on three stale-delta changes rather than author spec content
decisions.rationale: extract-gen-eval-package MODIFIES a heading that exists in no spec (already recorded in the 2026-08-28 session log). require-validating-roadmap-scaffolds and extend-coordinator-keys-to-new-harnesses carry MODIFIED blocks missing scenarios that superseding changes have since added. Reconciling them is spec authoring.

next_steps: Owner decision on extract-gen-eval-package, require-validating-roadmap-scaffolds, extend-coordinator-keys-to-new-harnesses
